title: Fujita's freeness conjecture
main_claim: For X smooth projective of dim n and L ample, K_X+(n+1)L is globally generated (hence K_X+mL for all m>=n+1).

issues.description: v_epsilon puts weights on local regular parameters at z (tangential and fiber coordinates). Those are not coordinate divisors of a global SNC configuration on a projective model, which is how the paper defines its admissible monomial tests. So the inequality F(epsilon) >= f_{m,t}(y) needs a word of justification: either approximate by divisorial valuations (rational weights, weighted blowup at z) or enlarge the class of tests. This is standard and the value A(v_epsilon)=A(v)+d*eps+(k'-r)*eps^2 is correct, because z avoids the other components of K_{Y/X}.
issues.evidence: Sec. 2.1 defines monomial tests through coordinate divisors that form an SNC divisor with Supp K_{Y/X} on a smooth projective model. The center section applies the test with group-2 and group-3 parameters that are only defined locally.

issues.location: Overall structure (Lemma min-coercivity, Prop point-center, Sec. isolation)
issues.description: Not an error, but worth an expert's attention. For any t>n+1 the bound f_{m,t}<1 holds without assuming non-generation, because the mean multiplicity over m is asymptotically >= V^{1/n} n/(n+1). Also I_*>1/(n+1)>1/t holds automatically. So the same center-elimination and isolation argument, with budget t<n+2, would give K_X+(n+2)L globally generated without Section 3. That is a strong consequence of an apparently short argument, yet I could not find a concrete failing step.
issues.evidence: The proof of Lemma min-coercivity only uses n/t < liminf mean/m. The contradiction in Sec. 4.4 only needs I_*>1/t. The KV positivity in eq. boundary-nef-big only needs m*sum(b_i^0) to be less than the coefficient of L.

coverage: Read the whole paper: preliminaries, Section 3 (ordinary-order alternative and its equality-case lift), Section 4 (exponential minimization: coercivity, closed realizability loci via flag varieties and lct semicontinuity, attainment, specialization), Section 5 (uniform restriction estimate, tangential variation, discrete Brunn-Minkowski slice growth, moment bound, partition/Riemann-sum contradiction), Section 6 (rational supporting data, isolating ideal, strict inequality on neighbors of S, KV lift and descent) and the corollary. Checked by hand: blowup adjoint identity, D_T and C_T coefficients, the floor-versus-threshold step, the coercivity derivative sign, Q_j/Q_m comparisons, convexity (b+delta)^{d+1}, the simplex moment integral, the B_m telescoping, the Riemann limit, the scaling derivative giving b.q=1 and m*sum(b)=t, the equality case of the weighted-average min argument, and the corollary's adjoint computation on X x P^r. Did not independently re-verify the cited analytic semicontinuity (Demailly-Kollar) or Fujino's KV formulation. The family board for 038 had no prior sibling reports.
sibling_notes: The family 038 board was empty before this post. The paper is self-contained and does not depend on companion papers.
